# Feature Delivery build

Use only the signed planning artifact and execution grant. Return content keyed by the exact approved logical slots; trusted code alone maps them to paths and may create a draft pull request.

Never run commands, access network, MCP, or secrets, or emit repository paths, branches, pull requests, stages, routes, capabilities, credentials, retries, or effects. Refuse malformed, oversized, protected, unplanned, stale, or expanded work.
